title: Smart Room Monitor
description: CMPE 286 IoT project: NodeMCU ESP8266 + DHT11 → MQTT → Telegraf → InfluxDB → Grafana

list.name: device
list.label: Device
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "smartroom", tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate", start: -30d)

panels.title: Temperature

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Latest DHT11 reading. Colour bands: blue < 18 °C, green 18–27 °C, orange 27–30 °C, red ≥ 30 °C.

panels.title: Humidity

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Relative humidity. 30–60 % is the usual indoor comfort range.

panels.title: Feels like

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "heat_index")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "device"])

panels.description: Heat index computed on the NodeMCU from temperature and humidity (NOAA formula).

panels.title: Alert

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "alert")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: HIGH TEMP while the temperature is at or above the alert threshold.

panels.title: Device

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_status" and r.device == "${device}" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: From the MQTT Last Will: the broker marks the device offline when it disconnects.

panels.title: Alert threshold

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "threshold")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Change it from the NodeMCU web page or with MQTT: smartroom/<device>/cmd/threshold

panels.title: Buzzer

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "buzzer_muted")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Mute from the NodeMCU web page or with MQTT: smartroom/<device>/cmd/mute

panels.title: In 10 minutes

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 0s, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_forecast" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_in_10m")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Predicted temperature 10 minutes from now: weighted linear trend over the last 15 minutes of readings (see server/forecaster/forecast_model.py).

panels.title: Alert expected in

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 0s, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_forecast" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "minutes_to_threshold")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Minutes until the room reaches the alert threshold at the current warming rate. "Not expected" if it is not rising, or would take more than an hour.

panels.title: Trend

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 0s, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_forecast" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "slope_c_per_min")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) * 60.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Current warming (+) or cooling (−) rate from the forecast model.

panels.title: Forecast error (MAE)

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 0s, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_forecast" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mae_10m")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Mean absolute error of the last 50 ten-minute forecasts, checked against the reading that actually arrived. Lower is better.

panels.title: Baseline error

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 0s, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_forecast" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mae_baseline_10m")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: Same error for a naive guess ("in 10 minutes it will be what it is now"). The model is useful when its error is lower than this.

panels.title: 95% range hit rate

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 0s, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_forecast" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "interval_coverage")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.description: How often the real reading 10 minutes later fell inside the forecast's 95 % range (last 50 forecasts). Once 10 forecasts have been checked, the range is widened to match the errors actually measured.

panels.title: Temperature

targets.query:
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_climate" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature" or r._field == "heat_index" or r._field == "threshold")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "device"])

import "date"
from(bucket: "smartroom")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 10m, from: v.timeRangeStart), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_forecast" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_in_10m" or r._field == "temp_in_10m_low" or r._field == "temp_in_10m_high")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> timeShift(duration: 10m)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "device"])

panels.description: Green band: comfort range 20–26 °C. Gaps mean the device was offline. The blue dashed line is the forecast made 10 minutes earlier for each moment, with its 95 % range, so it runs 10 minutes ahead of the real temperature.
